description: A range filter. Matches rows where min <= value <= max. At least one of either 'min' or 'max' must be set for this range to be valid.

key.description: The column name to filter on.

min.description: The minimum value in the range (inclusive). At least one of either 'min' or 'max' must be set.

max.description: The maximum value in the range (inclusive). At least one of either 'min' or 'max' must be set.
